Nabu · Brand-kit integration

The Nabu identity, wired into the app.

mypy --strict
ruff check + format
pytest 1562 green

A single art kit — mascot, app icon, pivot mark, three new RETICLE themes, and a laser-dodge boot splash — dropped into the real PySide6 shell. Every asset is byte-for-byte from the source SVGs; the new themes ride the existing instrument stylesheet with no per-theme QSS; the header mascot is now a living mark. Screenshots below are the actual Qt widgets, captured headless.

Twelve themes, one instrument

6 shown · 12 shipped

Every colour is a token. The accent stays rationed to live state — focus, hover, selection, the primary action — so a status can never be mistaken for a control. The picker now ships twelve themes (the six below plus Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox, Solarized, Tokyo Night, Monokai); the mascot is constant across all of them — it is the brand, not a theme.

The living mark · OwlMark

The owl watches the cursor.

The vendored mascot SVG is rendered as a still base minus its pupils and highlights; OwlMark paints those on top, so the gaze tracks the pointer and the owl blinks on a slow, random cadence. Eye geometry tracks the SVG exactly.

  • Pupils travel toward the cursor, clamped inside the sclera.
  • A ~190 ms blink every 3–8 s; nothing that distracts under exam pressure.
  • Offline and cheap; renders as a still mark under headless test — timers never idle-hang.

Boot sequence — the laser-dodge splash

native Qt · offline

While the app boots, Nabu ducks, leans and hops through a grid of red security lasers — Mission-Impossible style — with a cyan recon scan sweeping across and a rotating status line. Rebuilt as native Qt (one elapsed clock drives every beat): no WebEngine (fragile in the Kali VM), it degrades gracefully and never blocks startup.

App identity

One icon, every size.

A rounded-square app mark with radar rings behind the owl — vendored as SVG plus rasters at 16→512 px for the taskbar, favicons, and the packaging bundle. A matching tunnel mark ships for the pivot / WireGuard surface.
